summary: Add the Ansible Developer Tools server as an extra container in the RHDH Helm chart under `upstream.backstage.extraContainers`: image `registry.redhat.io/ansible-automation-platform-26/ansible-dev-tools-rhel9:latest`, command `adt server`, port 8000, `imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent` (or Always).
questions: How do I add the ansible-devtools-server container to RHDH?
Which image runs the Ansible dev tools server?
What port does adt server use?

answer_card.title: Ansible dev tools container for RHDH (Helm)
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
upstream:
  backstage:
    extraContainers:
      - command: [adt, server]
        image: >-
          registry.redhat.io/ansible-automation-platform-26/ansible-dev-tools-rhel9:latest
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent   # Always to get the newest image
        name: ansible-devtools-server
        ports:
          - containerPort: 8000
```
